sources.title: L4D Vanilla Server ADMIN Commands (L4D1) - banid (mins) (STEAMID) kick, removeid, status, users, listid, writeid
Left 4 Dead Dedicated Server (SteamCMD) [Windows] - app_update 222840, srcds -game left4dead -port 27015, rcon_password
Console Command List - Valve Developer Community (banid, removeid, listid, kick, say)
srcds.com forums - kickid <userid | uniqueid> {message}, reason unquoted (engine-level, not L4D1-specific)
Legion Hosting KB - Left 4 Dead Admin and Commands (kickid [userid], banid [minutes] [steamid], removeid [steamid], status)
steam-condenser issue #94 - real L4D2 rcon status capture showing STEAM_1:0: ids (same Source status format as L4D1)

notes: Standard Valve Source RCON over TCP on the SAME port as the game's UDP port (default 27015, set with the -port launch argument; cvar hostport). RCON is enabled purely by setting rcon_password in server.cfg - there is no separate enable switch, so enableSetting is null. banid takes the duration FIRST, in MINUTES, with 0 meaning permanent; the trailing literal 'kick' makes it also drop the player immediately - the L4D1 admin guide gives exactly 'banid (mins) (STEAMID) kick', and the Legion Hosting KB independently gives 'banid [minutes] [steamid]' with 0 = permanent. banid and removeid only change the in-memory ban list - run writeid afterwards to persist to banned_user.cfg, or the ban/unban is lost on restart. kickid's message is free text and must NOT be quoted (quotes are sent literally); the srcds.com thread confirms both 'kickid 11 Please do not swear' and 'kickid STEAM_0:1:223 Please do not swear' work, so kick and ban can be driven by the same identifier. status output lines look like: #250 1 "MorgueFish" STEAM_1:0:117097 11:02 92 0 active 25000 89.15.76.143:27005 - that capture (steam-condenser issue #94) is from an L4D2 server and L4D1 shares the engine's status format; older/other builds print a single leading number instead of two, so the line pattern accepts either. Bot rows carry BOT instead of a Steam ID and are deliberately excluded, since bots cannot be banned by Steam ID. No motd command exists: the MOTD is the motd.txt file in the game directory, so commands.motd is omitted. Disagreement: hosting-provider docs document only 'kick <playername>', which moderates by NAME and would not match the Steam ID that banid needs; the L4D2 command dump (identical engine) lists both kick (by name) and kickid (by userid or uniqueid), and kickid is used here. Note the Valve wiki describes kick as 'Kick a player by slot, userid or name', which is broader than the dumps' 'by name'. Game directory is left4dead (srcds -game left4dead, app_update 222840 validate). L4D1 caveat, CORRECTED ON REVIEW: banid, removeid, status, users, listid and writeid are documented in L4D1 sources directly, but the L4D1 hosting KB documents kickid ONLY in its by-userid form ('kickid [userid]') - it does not state the Steam ID form. No L4D1-specific source documents kickid accepting a STEAM_ uniqueid; that form rests on the engine-level srcds.com thread plus the L4D2 command dump, so treat kickid-by-Steam-ID as engine-inherited rather than L4D1-documented.
